subject.title: message_tool_only: one-shot delivery reminder loses to recency over long tool chains, turns end in withheld finals

question: For message_tool_only stranded finals, should OpenClaw prioritize periodic in-turn delivery reminders, a same-turn recovery retry from the existing withhold warning path, or both?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps private finals private, while the suggested fixes change recovery semantics and can affect source-channel delivery guarantees; automation should not choose that policy while overlapping recovery PRs are open.

options.title: Retry from withhold path
options.body: Use the existing private-final detection point to queue one guarded same-turn recovery prompt, preserving private-final suppression unless the model explicitly calls the message tool.

options.title: Refresh reminders during tools
options.body: Append a compact delivery reminder after long tool chains to reduce stranded finals without adding an automatic recovery turn.

options.title: Combine both after design review
options.body: Adopt periodic reminders plus one guarded recovery retry, with tests proving no raw private final is auto-delivered or persisted as user-visible output.

recommendation.title: Retry from withhold path
recommendation.body: Use the existing private-final detection point to queue one guarded same-turn recovery prompt, preserving private-final suppression unless the model explicitly calls the message tool.
